title: packera paupercula var. pseudotomentosa
intro: Packera paupercula var. pseudotomentosa, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Ragwort, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are said to have various health benefits, including reducing fever and relieving gastrointestinal issues. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive problems, reducing pain, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
